title: Exact derived comparison of global and open local module stalks
statement: Let X,Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y, K a cochain complex of O_X-modules, V an open of X, L a cochain complex of O_X-modules on the slice over V, and eL an isomorphism in the chosen derived category between restriction of QK to V and QL [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume chosen global and slice derived categories, and let y∈V. For any chosen derived category of A=O_Y,f(y)-modules, Q(restrict along f.stalkMap y of the global module stalk of K [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]) is isomorphic to Q(restrict along f.stalkMap y of S_V,y L), where S_V,y is the explicit open module stalk functor [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. There is no K-flatness, tensor, boundedness or perfectness hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 06YB (lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), 08CG and 09U9; Modules Tag 01AG; Sheaves Tags 008H and 0098; comparison step in Tag 0B6G condition (3). Sources checked online.

proof.text: Apply the open restriction stalk extension isomorphism to V.ι and K. Restrict scalars back along the open immersion stalk map; since that ring map is an isomorphism the extension/restriction adjunction unit is invertible. Compose with the termwise image of Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V to identify the global module stalk of K with openModuleStalkFunctor applied to the slice restriction of K.

Let F be slice restriction and S be openModuleStalkFunctor followed by restriction along f.stalkMap y. Compose the inverse of S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors at F(K), the S-derived image of the inverse F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors at K followed by eL, and S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors at L. Compose this with Q of the scalar-restricted complex comparison from step 1. All commutation isomorphisms are Mathlib Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors for exact additive functors.

theorem relativeTensor_global_local_stalk_derived_iso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (V : X.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ)
    (eL : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L))
    (y : X) (hy : y ∈ V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)))] :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace y).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨y, hy⟩).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj L)))
